metas.name: Jackass Presents: Bad Grandpa
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Barb & Star Go to Vista Del Mar

86-year-old Irving Zisman takes a trip from Nebraska to North Carolina to take his 8 year-old grandson, Billy, back to his real father.

metas.name: Deep Water
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Gone Girl

A well-to-do husband who allows his wife to have affairs in order to avoid a divorce becomes a prime suspect in the disappearance of her lovers.

metas.name: Paycheck
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Inception

A technical wizard learns that his memory has been erased.

metas.name: Beastie Boys Story
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Madonna: Truth or Dare

Here's a little story they're about to tell... Michael Diamond and Adam Horovitz share the story of the band, Beastie Boys, and 40 years of friendship in a live documentary experience directed by friend and collaborator, Spike Jonze.

metas.name: Alien: Covenant
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Thing

The crew of a colony ship, bound for a remote planet, discover an uncharted paradise with a threat beyond their imagination, and must attempt a harrowing escape.

metas.name: Stonehearst Asylum
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Twelve Monkeys

When Dr Edward Newgate arrives at the asylum to begin his residency, he finds the Dr in charge has adopted unusual methods of treatment, methods that give his patients a lot of freedom. But cracks appear in the hospital's cheerful...

metas.name: The Boondock Saints
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Departed

Two Irish Catholic brothers become vigilantes in order to try to wipe out Boston's criminal underworld in the name of God.

metas.name: The Andromeda Strain
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Contagion

Top scientists work feverishly in a secret, state-of-the-art laboratory to discover what killed the citizens of a small town and how the deadly contagion can be stopped.

metas.name: Head Above Water
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Barb & Star Go to Vista Del Mar

A prominent judge, his wife, her ex-lover, and their neighbor encounter a dead body that complicates their lives.

metas.name: Presumed Innocent
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Gone Girl

As a lawyer investigates the murder of a colleague, he finds himself more connected to the crime than anyone else.

metas.name: Push
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Inception

Two young Americans with special abilities must race to find a girl in Hong Kong before a shadowy government organization called Division does.

metas.name: Selena Gomez: My Mind & Me
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Madonna: Truth or Dare

After years in the limelight, Selena Gomez achieves unimaginable stardom. But just as she reaches a new peak, an unexpected turn pulls her into darkness.

metas.name: Prometheus
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Thing

Following clues to the origin of mankind, a team finds a structure on a distant moon, but they soon realize they are not alone.

metas.name: A Scanner Darkly
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Twelve Monkeys

An undercover cop in a not-too-distant future becomes involved with a dangerous new drug and begins to lose his own identity as a result.

metas.name: The Friends of Eddie Coyle
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Departed

After his last crime has him looking at a long prison sentence for repeat offenses, a low level Boston gangster decides to snitch on his friends to avoid jail time.

metas.name: The Core
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Contagion

The only way to save Earth from catastrophe is to drill down to the core and set it spinning again.

metas.name: Married to the Mob
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Barb & Star Go to Vista Del Mar

A mobster's wife who hates her lifestyle gets a chance to change it when her husband is killed - if the Long Island mob and the FBI will only let her.

metas.name: Endless Night
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Gone Girl

A working-class young Englishman marries an affable American heiress, but their marital bliss is soon interrupted when they begin constructing a home on land alleged to be cursed.

metas.name: Gemini Man
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Inception

An over-the-hill hitman faces off against a younger clone of himself.

metas.name: Tupac: Resurrection
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Madonna: Truth or Dare

Home movies, photographs, and recited poetry illustrate the life of Tupac Shakur, one of the most beloved, revolutionary, and volatile hip-hop M.Cs. of all time.

metas.name: Event Horizon
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Thing

A rescue crew is tasked with investigating the mysterious reappearance of a spaceship that had been lost for seven years.

metas.name: Open Grave
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Twelve Monkeys

A man wakes up with no memory in a pit full of dead bodies in the wilderness and must determine if the murderer is one of the strangers who rescued him, or if he himself is the killer.

metas.name: The Town
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Departed

A proficient group of thieves rob a bank and hold the manager hostage. Things begin to get complicated when one of the crew members falls in love with her.

metas.name: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Contagion

A substance designed to help the brain repair itself gives advanced intelligence to a chimpanzee who leads an ape uprising.

metas.name: Clerks II
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Barb & Star Go to Vista Del Mar

A calamity at Dante and Randal's shops sends them looking for new horizons - but they ultimately settle at the fast food empire Mooby's.

metas.name: Lantana
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Gone Girl

The relationships of four couples unravel after the discovery of a young woman's body in Lantana bush in suburban Sydney.

metas.name: Dirty Mary Crazy Larry
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Inception

Down-on-their-luck racers Larry and Deke steal from a supermarket manager to buy a car that will help them advance their racing chances. Their escape does not go as planned when Larry's one-night stand, Mary, tags along for the ride.

metas.name: Homecoming: A Film by Beyoncé
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Madonna: Truth or Dare

This intimate, in-depth look at Beyoncé's celebrated 2018 Coachella performance reveals the emotional road from creative concept to cultural movement.

metas.name: Body Snatchers
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Thing

A teenage girl and her father discover alien clones are replacing humans on a remote U.S. military base in Alabama.

metas.name: The Island
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Twelve Monkeys

In 2019, a mercenary pursues a man and woman who escaped a research facility after learning their true fate.

metas.name: Donnie Brasco
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Departed

An FBI undercover agent infiltrates the mob and finds himself identifying more with the Mafia life--at the expense of his regular one.

metas.name: Terminator Genisys
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Contagion

When John Connor, leader of the human resistance, sends Sgt. Kyle Reese back to 1984 to protect Sarah Connor and safeguard the future, an unexpected turn of events creates a fractured timeline.

metas.name: The Package
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Barb & Star Go to Vista Del Mar

When a group of teenage friends goes on a spring-break camping trip, an unfortunate accident sets off a race against time to save one friend's most prized possession.

metas.name: Dream Lover
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Gone Girl

An intricate game of erotic entrapment unfolds as an architect begins to suspect the dark secrets his too-good-to-be-true wife may be hiding.

metas.name: RoboCop
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Inception

In 2028 Detroit, when Alex Murphy, a loving husband, father and good cop, is critically injured in the line of duty, the multinational conglomerate OmniCorp sees their chance for a part-man, part-robot police officer.

metas.name: Rolling Thunder Revue: A Bob Dylan Story by Martin Scorsese
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Madonna: Truth or Dare

In an alchemic mix of fact and fantasy, Martin Scorsese looks back at Bob Dylan's 1975 Rolling Thunder Revue tour and a country ripe for reinvention.

metas.name: Lifeforce
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Thing

A race of space vampires arrives in London and infects the populace, beginning an apocalyptic descent into chaos.

metas.name: Die Alone
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Twelve Monkeys

Tells the story of a young man who has amnesia. He bands together with a rugged survivalist in a zombie-like outbreak to find his girlfriend.

metas.name: Gone Baby Gone
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Departed

Two Boston area detectives investigate a little girl's kidnapping, which ultimately turns into a crisis both professionally and personally.

metas.name: The Day After Tomorrow
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Contagion

When a sudden international storm plunges the planet into a new Ice Age, a paleoclimatologist must make a daring trek to reach his son.

metas.name: Soul Men
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Barb & Star Go to Vista Del Mar

Though it's been about twenty years since they have spoken with one another, two estranged soul-singing legends agree to participate in a reunion performance at the Apollo Theater to honor their recently deceased band leader.

metas.name: Triage
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Gone Girl

The wife of a photojournalist sets out to discover why he came home from a recent assignment without his colleague.

metas.name: Minority Report
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Inception

The chief of a police unit that can accurately predict and prevent crimes goes on the run after he's accused of a future murder himself.

metas.name: Sign 'o' the Times
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Madonna: Truth or Dare

Highlights from Prince's 1987 European concert tour, including selections from the rock star's album of the same title.

metas.name: Sphere
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Thing

A spaceship is discovered under three hundred years' worth of coral growth at the bottom of the ocean.

metas.name: I Am Legend
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Twelve Monkeys

Years after a plague kills most of humanity and transforms the rest into monsters, the sole survivor in New York City struggles valiantly to find a cure.

metas.name: Sleepless
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Departed

An officer with a connection to the criminal underworld scours a nightclub in search of his kidnapped son.

metas.name: Sleep Dealer
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Contagion

The near future. Like tomorrow. In a world marked by closed borders, corporate warriors, and a global computer network, three strangers risk their lives to connect, break through the barriers of technology, and unseal their fates.

metas.name: Horrible Bosses
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Barb & Star Go to Vista Del Mar

Three friends conspire to murder their awful bosses when they realize they are standing in the way of their happiness.

metas.name: Kiss the Girls
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Gone Girl

A forensic psychologist teams with an escaped captive to hunt a serial kidnapper who collects strong-willed women, only to discover the killer operates within a network of psychopaths.

metas.name: Heart of Stone
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Inception

An intelligence operative for a shadowy global peacekeeping agency races to stop a hacker from stealing its most valuable and dangerous weapon.

metas.name: Pandorum
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Thing

Two crew members of a spaceship wake up from hypersleep to discover that all their colleagues are missing. Despite this, it appears that they are not alone.

metas.name: The Bay
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Twelve Monkeys

Chaos breaks out in a small Maryland town after an ecological disaster occurs.

metas.name: Finestkind
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Departed

A crew of fishermen tread dangerous waters when their debts start piling up.

metas.name: Light of My Life
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Contagion

A father and his child journey through the outskirts of society a decade after a pandemic has wiped out half the world's population. As the father struggles to protect his child, their bond and the character of humanity are tested.

metas.name: The Whisper Man
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Gone Girl

A grieving father and his young son relocate to the quiet town of Featherbank, which was terrorized by a serial killer known as The Whisper Man 15 years earlier, while rumors circulated that Whisper Man worked with an accomplice.

metas.name: 16 Blocks
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Inception

An aging alcoholic cop is assigned the task of escorting a witness from police custody to a courthouse 16 blocks away. There are, however, chaotic forces at work that prevent them from making it in one piece.

metas.name: Invasion of the Body Snatchers
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Thing

When strange seeds drift to earth from space, mysterious pods begin to grow and invade San Francisco, replicating the city's residents one body at a time.

metas.name: Dark City
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Twelve Monkeys

A man struggles with memories of his past, which include a wife he cannot remember and a nightmarish world no one else ever seems to wake up from.

metas.name: Criminal Activities
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved The Departed

Four young men make a risky investment together that puts them in trouble with the mob.
